interpretation_boundary: These five marks and the unit specification name structure in a target numeric-carrier design. They are not operations, not a calculus, not a precision guarantee, not an acceptance rule and not a proof. They annotate material that already has homes: the exact residual carriers in the native witness crate, and the receipt fields and kinds in the golden-ratio receipt home. Registering a mark creates no second home for residual, fuel, frame or bracket, and grants no numeric authority.

terms.name: closed-core
terms.effect: Name the part of a computation that is carried exactly, with no rounding, inside a declared arithmetic domain.
input: an exact coefficient domain, such as rationals or the integer polynomials the native residual already carries
a declared degree or size budget for the core
preconditions: The coefficient domain is exact and declared
No unresolved shell term appears inside a core expression
Core operations are declared, and inversion is by pair swap rather than scalar division
preserves: Associativity and distributivity as exact identities over the core
The existing native exact carriers, which this mark annotates rather than replaces
Lineage and occurrence distinctions, which exactness must not erode
does_not_imply: A closed core with a native operation, a stable keyword, a semantic identity or an admission
A closed core with permission to collapse the whole computation to a value
The bracket [] with the [] of the typed-aperture presentation `{}[]()` in the hole machinery: that presentation labels three local triangular interfaces and is a different home
A closed core with a claim that the computation as a whole is exact

witness.reference: 苑明理方案提议一.md §2.2 and §5; crates/adva-witness/src/arithmetic.rs MultiplicativeResidualV0 and ThreeSideAdditiveResidualV0
witness.description: No core/shell machine exists. The exact half already exists natively as exact integer-polynomial residual pairs with identity 1/1, and as typed residuals that refuse cross-side scalar cancellation.

refusal: A core operation outside the declared domain: refuse, never approximate
A zero denominator in the core: refuse
A binary64 value entering the core: refuse
terms.replay: Nothing executes yet, so nothing is replayed. The nearest executable precedent is the exact-arithmetic family of bounded experiments.
residual: The shell contract that decides what leaves the core
The degree or size budget and its declared truncation rule
The connection between this mark and the existing receipt fields

terms.name: open-shell
terms.effect: Name the part of a computation the declared budget did not resolve, carried explicitly instead of being rounded away.
input: the unresolved remainder of a computation
the fuel that was available and the point at which it was exhausted
the path or step that produced the remainder
preconditions: A shell is produced only by declared budget exhaustion or by a declared refusal, never by a rounding rule
A shell is never summed with a core term
An acceptance condition never compares a shell numerically
preserves: The unresolved part in an inspectable form
The distinction between resolved and not yet resolved
Every alternative, in the sense the aperture work already requires
does_not_imply: An open shell with a numeric tolerance or epsilon
An open shell with a bracket over produced values in the golden-ratio receipt sense: that bracket is a numeric interval with its own discipline and its own home
The parentheses () with iota-lang's parser (), or with the () of the typed-aperture presentation
An open shell with a failure, an error, or permission to stop checking
An open shell with a claim about how close the true value is

witness.reference: 苑明理方案提议一.md §3.2 solution three and §5; docs/terminology/golden-ratio-receipt-v0.json kinds `unknown-tail` and `finite-precision-stop`
witness.description: No carried numeric shell exists. The receipt home already names an unknown tail and a finite-precision stop, and carries fields for fuel used and residual; the mark names the structure those fields hold.

refusal: A shell produced by rounding: refuse
A shell compared as a number: refuse
residual: Whether the first shell form is a symbolically unexpanded term or a bounded numeric interval; the difference decides whether rounding is reintroduced
How a shell's frame is typed so that acceptance cannot read it

terms.name: modal-tension
terms.effect: Name the direction of an approximation carried together with its residual, including the reverse direction of the modal reading.
input: a shell, together with the direction in which it was produced
output: the potential for two opposite directions to cancel at a terminal step
preconditions: The direction is recorded where the residual is produced
Opposite directions are never cancelled through a scalar sum
preserves: The native principle already enforced by the typed additive residuals: coordinates from different sides never cancel one another through a scalar sum
does_not_imply: A direction with an oriented interval calculus, a Kaucher implementation or a native type
The angle brackets <> with iota-lang's parser brackets, which are a syntax form of an external substrate
A direction with a claim about which side the truth lies on

witness.reference: 苑明理方案提议一.md §5; crates/adva-witness/src/trace_arithmetic.rs ThreeSideAdditiveResidualV0
witness.description: The closest existing realisation is native: the three-side additive residual refuses scalar cancellation across sides, which is the direction-discipline this mark names. It is exact and typed, not numeric.

refusal: A direction folded into a scalar sign: refuse
A direction inferred from a numeric comparison: refuse
residual: The relation between this mark and the existing typed residuals
Whether direction survives when a shell is frozen

terms.name: projective-duality
terms.effect: Name carrying a ratio as a pair, so that inversion is a swap and no scalar division is performed.
input: numerator and denominator expressions over the declared exact domain
preconditions: Only the pair form is claimed
The zero test is decidable in the declared domain
preserves: The native exact after/before residual pair, whose identity is 1/1
The unit as a pair rather than as a scalar
does_not_imply: A pair form with an SL(2,Z) group element, or with a Mobius transformation of a general rational expression in several subexpressions: that holds for the one-variable Mobius fragment and for a single lifted ratio, and not in general

A projective lift with the removal of truncation: composing further forces a common denominator, so the decision relocates to a declared degree or ideal truncation, which the source document itself notes cannot be an ideal once division is present
The notation [< >] with a lattice, a polarity, a mirror or a Calabi-Yau construction: those have their own home in the geometry-boundaries terms and must not be conflated
A pair form with a value: the pair is an expression, and no collapse follows from it

witness.reference: crates/adva-witness/src/arithmetic.rs MultiplicativeResidualV0 (`after / before` as two exact PolynomialV0 with BigInt coefficients, identity 1/1)
witness.description: An exact symbolic realisation already exists natively and is tested; it carries no budget and no shell, which is exactly what the notation still lacks.

refusal: Scalar division inside the core: refuse
Exceeding the degree budget without declaring a shell: refuse
terms.replay: python3 -m pytest tests/python -k arithmetic, and the witness crate tests; both cover the existing exact pair and neither covers a shell.
residual: The degree or ideal budget, and whether truncation is declared by degree rather than by an ideal
Whether the pair view survives superposition of two ratios

terms.name: centripetal-balance
terms.effect: Name the terminal step at which carried shells are emptied and the computation collapses, or does not.
output: a collapse with empty shells, or Unknown with the shells retained
preconditions: Collapse only when the shells are empty
preserves: Everything carried up to that point; no silent convergence
does_not_imply: A terminal collapse with a limit that always converges: the source document's limit expression is prose in the clothing of a limit and needs a finite form first
A collapse with permission to drop a non-empty shell
This parentheses pair with any existing notation
A collapse with a proof of correctness

witness.reference: 苑明理方案提议一.md §5 dynamics convergence condition; docs/maintenance/FLOAT_APERTURES.md
witness.description: No terminal reduction exists. The repository's existing rule that exhaustion produces Unknown is the shape this mark must obey rather than a mechanism it may replace.

refusal: Collapsing while a shell is non-empty: refuse
Reporting a value at exhaustion: refuse
residual: The finite form of the convergence condition, including what happens at exhaustion
Whether a refusal counts as a shell

terms.name: unit-specification
terms.effect: Name the target specification diagram for the unit as a balanced configuration of the five marks.
output: a specification to be validated, not an equation
preconditions: It is stated as a target specification, not as an identity
If it is ever to carry authority it must become a validated diagram at the Rust boundary rather than a formula in prose
does_not_imply: An equation or a proven identity
A definition of the number one
A native diagram, a certificate, an admission or a Seal
The interpretation that the unit is not a dead scalar: that is a reading offered by the source document, not a result, and it is not asserted here

related_homes.carries: exact multiplicative residual as an after/before pair of exact integer polynomials, identity 1/1
typed additive residuals that refuse cross-side scalar cancellation
rejection residuals, and a frozen distributivity identity that must be transported
receipt fields including fuel_used, frame, residual and claim_scope, and the kinds unknown-tail and finite-precision-stop

proposed_call_order: state the expression fragment and its exact coefficient domain
state the degree or size budget for the core, and the rule that decides truncation
carry what the budget did not resolve as the declared shell, with its frame
record the direction with the shell
compare cores and shell emptiness, never values, and never a host quantity
on exhaustion, freeze the shell and return Unknown with the shell retained; never collapse

gates.coverage_gated_close: May close only the declared fragment; cannot discharge the shell contract

gates.numeric_guarantee: None: a mark is a name, not a bound
